One painted still (gilded_aegis_lock.png, 1254x1254), a closed shield outline of interlocking gold plates with a small crown and a thin halo ring, centre open, on a #00FF00 green screen. The halo glow came back lime-yellow, so cap_green pulls lime pixels to gold.
